intro.h2: Kitchen countertops and backsplashes that change the whole room
paragraphs: H&I kitchen/bathroom remodeling Llc works on the surfaces you look at every day: kitchen countertops and backsplashes, plus fresh paint and bathroom remodels. One client hired H&I for a kitchen mini makeover, with a new backsplash and paint, and says it turned out better than she expected.

Clients know the people behind the work by name. Hector leads the crew, Isaura stays in touch from the start of a project to the end, and Lisa helps homeowners decide the best way to get the kitchen or bathroom they want. One couple says Hector even repaired a faulty valve under the sink that he noticed while installing their quartz counters.

services.h2: What H&I does in kitchens and baths

items.name: Granite and quartz countertops
items.blurb: Countertops are the job reviewers mention most. One family has hired H&I twice for countertops and says the second time won't be the last, and the owner praised the granite they picked. Another couple says they could not be more pleased with their new quartz counters.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with blue-gray granite countertops and matte black bar pulls

items.name: Backsplash replacement
items.blurb: A new backsplash can make an older kitchen feel current while the cabinets stay put. H&I takes out the old tile and sets the new one, like the white handmade-look subway tile in this cherry wood kitchen. Backsplash replacement is a topic in two Google reviews.

image.alt: White subway tile backsplash under cherry cabinets and a wood range hood, with freshly painted white walls

items.name: Kitchen painting
items.blurb: Paint was half of the kitchen mini makeover one client hired H&I to do. Fresh wall color next to a new backsplash gives a room with dark wood cabinets a lighter, cleaner look. Ask about painting when you call so both jobs are planned together.

image.alt: Wide view of a kitchen with cherry cabinets, a wine rack, light painted walls and a white tile backsplash

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms are in the company's name, and one couple says Hector and Lisa are the ones to call for kitchen and bath remodeling projects. Tell them what bothers you about your bathroom today, and they will help you work out the best way to fix it.

process.h2: How a project with H&I goes

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (919) 740-2104 Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, or email handiremodelingllc@gmail.com, and describe the kitchen or bath you want to change.

steps.title: Pick your materials
steps.text: Choose your countertop and backsplash. Hector and Lisa help you decide the best way to get the look you want, whether granite or quartz.

steps.title: Agree on the plan
steps.text: You agree on the scope, the price and the schedule before any old countertop or tile comes out of your kitchen.

steps.title: Install and finish
steps.text: Hector and his crew install the counters, set the tile and paint, and Isaura keeps you updated from start to end.

steps.title: See the result
steps.text: Look over the finished room together. One client was happy enough to post her before and after pictures on Google for others to see.

service_area.text: H&I kitchen/bathroom remodeling Llc is a service-area business, so the crew comes to your home. Google does not list a street address or the towns they cover. Call (919) 740-2104 or email handiremodelingllc@gmail.com with your town and a short description of the kitchen or bathroom, and ask whether your home is in their area. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

items.q: Do you install both granite and quartz countertops?
items.a: Yes. Google reviews cover both. One family chose granite for their second countertop project with H&I, and the owner told them the stone they picked was really beautiful. Another couple had quartz countertops and a new backsplash installed and says they could not be more pleased with the work.

items.q: Can you replace just the backsplash and paint?
items.a: Yes. One client hired H&I for a kitchen mini makeover: the backsplash was replaced and the kitchen was painted, and she says it turned out better than she expected. A smaller project like this updates the room while your cabinets and counters stay in place.

Yes. Bathrooms are part of the business name, and one couple says Hector and Lisa are the ones to call for all kitchen and bath remodeling projects. Call (919) 740-2104 to describe your bathroom and what you would like to change, and they can help you decide the best approach.

H&I is open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (919) 740-2104 during those hours, or email handiremodelingllc@gmail.com at any time with photos of your kitchen or bath and a short note about the project.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call or email to request an estimate. The price depends on the countertop material, the backsplash tile and how much of the kitchen is involved, so measurements or a few photos help. You agree on the price with H&I before any work begins.

final_cta.text: Call H&I Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and tell Hector's team what your kitchen needs.
